lede: The Rangers had last change, so Mike Sullivan picked most of these matchups. The Rangers played without Joseph Veleno. Vancouver played without Arshdeep Bains and Jamie Oleksiak.

notes.head: The fourth line drew Gallagher’s line
notes.text: Mike Sullivan sent Bjorkstrand, Chmelař and Beaudoin out for 5:01 of their 9:24 at 5-on-5 against Gallagher, Räty and Sasson (53%, about 23% with no line matching).

notes.head: Lafrenière’s line drew E. Pettersson’s line
notes.text: Miller, Kartye and Lafrenière spent 7:49 of their 14:28 at 5-on-5 against DeBrusk, E. Pettersson and Lekkerimäki (54%, about 25% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.67 to 0.17 expected goals. The Rangers scored one of their six goals then.

notes.head: Zibanejad’s line drew Boeser’s line
notes.text: Zibanejad, Dorofeyev and Perreault spent 8:55 of their 16:21 at 5-on-5 against Boeser, Cotter and Rossi (55%, about 29% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.39 to 0.23 expected goals.

notes.head: One matchup paid off
notes.text: Tolvanen, Cuylle and Laba kept drawing Vancouver’s third line, Karlsson, O'Connor and Öhgren. In those 4:17 the Rangers had 0.83 expected goals to Vancouver’s 0.08. The Rangers scored two of their six goals then.

foot: Mike Sullivan matched harder than in his other home games: each line spent 50% of its time against one opposing line, against 34% to 42% in his first three.
